name: disk-full
notes: Disk free space crosses the 15% pressure boundary at T+5s and the 5% exhaustion boundary at T+15s.
Pressure escalates to exhaustion within one free-space episode (ESCALATES_TO): v1 cannot observe write failures or inode state, so no CAUSES claim is made.
With no rule-backed causal edge, the report names DISK_EXHAUSTED as the observed failure and root cause UNKNOWN.

Re-audit 2026-10-28 (principal, causal-semantics.md §5.2 clarified): a failure is never its own candidate, and an escalation-only path is the anchor's own episode (known chain), not a contributing factor. Suspected-kill/write-failure alternatives explain exit failures only, never a condition anchor.

missing_evidence_includes: write-failure / ENOSPC telemetry is not captured in v1 bundles
